horses.name: Deku
horses.description: The ultimate underdog "dark horse" champion. He is the type of colt that wins the Triple Crown after starting his life completely overlooked.

horses.name: Shoto
horses.description: A striking, dual-natured physical presence and a devastating, high-stamina running style.

horses.name: Great Explosion Murder God Dynamight
horses.description: An exceptionally talented but notoriously volatile colt.

horses.name: Froppy
horses.description: A standout, fan-favorite turf sprinter known for her exceptional agility, unusual physical quirks, and remarkable consistency in wet track conditions.

horses.name: Uravity
horses.description: When she accelerates, railbirds swear her hooves barely touch the ground, moving with a fluid, gravity-defying grace that makes a grueling mile-and-a-half stretch look like a casual breeze.

horses.name: Creati
horses.description: A regal, elite-class classic distance closer known for tactical brilliance, immense stamina reserves, and a highly specific nutritional regimen
